metadata.description: Plugins for running an AI-native software development lifecycle with Claude Code

plugins.name: ai-native-sdlc
plugins.description: The shared half of the AI-native SDLC: skills that write intent.md, spec.md and plan.md; verifier, simplifier and researcher agents; user-invocable skills for each stage gate and an /adopt skill for existing repos; and guardrail hooks that protect tests during a fix and keep secrets out of the diff.
